title: A second path elsewhere in the model does not make a query ambiguous
question: What is the return amount by year?
behavior: store_returns reaches date_dim only through return_date_id. store_sales has two paths to date_dim, but this query does not join store_sales or store, so it is valid. E_AMBIGUOUS_PATH applies only to paths between datasets that the lowering joins (Section 8, row 17).
